about_the_game:
Hollow Mine is an action rogue-lite that combines mining, crafting, and intense 2D top-down combat. Looking for your next addiction? Try this extremely satisfying experience!

Fight enemies in your own style using melee combat, range weapons or magic spells!

The game offers a variety of weapons. Improve them using mined resources and crafting.

Mine resources, destroy walls and dig tunnels!

Experience procedurally generated rooms with a fully destructible environment.

Demolish your foes with mining wagons, bombs and other deadly traps.

Explore diverse biomes, their unique environments, and countless ways to defeat enemies.

Shape your journey differently each run!

Pick rooms with various challenges and rewards. Experience over 100 unique procedurally generated rooms.

Level up and unlock powerful abilities!

Choose from more than 100 unique abilities that improve and transform your hero.

Face difficult bosses at the end of each biome!

Encounter over 20 unique boss fights, including a challenging final boss.

Take on high risk and high reward challenges during your runs!

Game offers over 20 unique challenges. Destroy enemy forts, capture the flags, defeat waves of enemies, find a key to escape a room, and much more.

Pick from multiple unlockable characters classes!

Unlock and play more than 20 different character classes. Each with its unique ability and starting equipment.

Craft and repair powerful weapons!

Use over 100 unique weapons and spells, each upgradable through crafting.

Find blueprints, gather herbs, dig ores, and loot treasures to create potions, weapons, and spells.

Complete rooms, find loot, and equip yourself with powerful items!

Checkout more than 250 items in the game

Interact with various NPC Characters!

Meet memorable characters and discover their stories. Buy and sell goods for gold, but beware - some decisions can have dire consequences.

Explore rich lore and hidden mysteries in depths of the Hollow Mine!

Dive deep into the lore, uncover all the mysteries, and complete the ultimate task: destroy the Weles Burden ring.

Features

  • Engage unique enemies from 5 biomes, featuring over 90 procedurally generated rooms. Over 20 challenging boss fights, including the final boss.

  • Explore an ever-changing world with high replayability value and rich variety each run!

  • Level up, get experience and pick from more than 100 unique abilities.

  • Experience a destructive environment in rooms, using your pickaxe mine resources and dig up walls to flank enemies.

  • Find Blueprints and construct your weapons and spells from scratch with resources.

  • Construct your own build with preferable play style, melee, range and magic spells!

  • Discover more than 100 weapons and spells, all upgradeable through crafting.

  • Utilize mining wagons, bombs, and biome-specific traps to crush foes.

  • Discover more than 250 items! Including equippable ones.

  • Fight over 20 unique and challenging boss fights including final boss throughout 5 biomes.

  • Play more than 20 unlockable character classes with unique abilities and starting gear.

  • Enjoy fast-paced runs in 40-minute or longer play sessions.

  • Explore rich lore and hidden mysteries in depths of the Hollow Mine!

  • Interact with various NPC Characters. Buy or sell goodies. Remember decisions can have bad consequences!

short_description: Hollow Mine is an action roguelite that combines mining, crafting, and intense 2D top-down combat. Explore unpredictable, ever-changing mines, battle fierce enemy hordes, and confront tough bosses. Engage, die, learn, and repeat as you uncover new challenges with every run.
